response.justification: The candidate is a versatile senior engineer with genuine geospatial platform experience (GISCollective, Green Map) and proven low-latency systems work in DLang handling millions of requests per second, which demonstrates transferable performance-engineering skills. However, the role's core requirement of modern C++ (or Rust) is weakly met — his C/C++ experience is brief and dates to 2015 — and he has no direct navigation/routing pipeline background. Recent work has been TypeScript/Node full-stack product development, making this a notable pivot.
strengths: Founder of an open-source geospatial data platform used in production (GISCollective / Green Map)
Low-latency, high-throughput systems experience with async I/O, caching, and fibers at Sociomantic
Demonstrated adaptability across stacks, strong testing culture, and Linux/DevOps competence
concerns: Modern C++ experience is minimal and ~10 years old; no Rust listed
No experience with routing engines, routing tiles, or navigation guidance systems
Recent roles (2020–present) are primarily TypeScript/Node full-stack, distant from the role's systems focus
